final: WITH c AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM disp p JOIN account a ON a.account_id = p.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), s AS (SELECT region, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), m AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - m.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s, m WHERE s.share > m.avg_share
